versos.grego: Ἐπειδὴ ἐπλήρωσεν πάντα τὰ ῥήματα αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς ἀκοὰς τοῦ λαοῦ, εἰσῆλθεν εἰς Καφαρναούμ.

controles.web: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
controles.kjv: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
controles.livre: E depois de acabar todos os seus discursos aos ouvidos do povo, ele entrou em Cafarnaum.

versos.grego: Ἑκατοντάρχου δέ τινος δοῦλος κακῶς ἔχων ἤμελλεν τελευτᾶν, ὃς ἦν αὐτῷ ἔντιμος.

controles.web: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
controles.kjv: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
controles.livre: E o servo de um certo centurião, a quem muito estimava, que estava doente, e a ponto de morrer.

versos.grego: ἀκούσας δὲ περὶ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτὸν πρεσβυτέρους τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ἐρωτῶν αὐτὸν ὅπως ἐλθὼν διασώσῃ τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
controles.kjv: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
controles.livre: E quando o centurião ouviu falar sobre Jesus, enviou-lhe uns anciãos dos judeus, rogando-lhe que viesse curar o seu servo.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ παραγενόμενοι πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν σπουδαίως, λέγοντες ὅτι ἄξιός ἐστιν ᾧ παρέξῃ τοῦτο·

controles.web: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,
controles.kjv: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
controles.livre: Eles vieram a Jesus, e rogaram-lhe com urgência, dizendo: Ele é digno de lhe concederes isto,

versos.grego: ἀγαπᾷ γὰρ τὸ ἔθνος ἡμῶν καὶ τὴν συναγωγὴν αὐτὸς ᾠκοδόμησεν ἡμῖν.

controles.web: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”
controles.kjv: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
controles.livre: porque ele ama a nossa nação, e ele mesmo construiu a nossa sinagoga.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐπορεύετο σὺν αὐτοῖς. ἤδη δὲ αὐτοῦ οὐ μακρὰν ἀπέχοντος ἀπὸ τῆς οἰκίας, ἔπεμψεν φίλους ὁ ἑκατοντάρχης λέγων αὐτῷ Κύριε, μὴ σκύλλου· οὐ γὰρ ἱκανός εἰμι ἵνα ὑπὸ τὴν στέγην μου εἰσέλθῃς·

controles.web: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.
controles.kjv: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
controles.livre: Jesus foi com eles; mas quando já não estava longe da casa, o centurião lhe enviou uns amigos, dizendo-lhe: “Senhor, não te incomodes, porque não sou digno que entres abaixo do meu telhado.

versos.grego: διὸ οὐδὲ ἐμαυτὸν ἠξίωσα πρὸς σὲ ἐλθεῖν· ἀλλὰ εἰπὲ λόγῳ, καὶ ἰαθήτω ὁ παῖς μου.

controles.web: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.
controles.kjv: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
controles.livre: Por isso que nem mesmo me considerei digno de vir a ti; mas diz uma palavra, e o meu servo sarará.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπός εἰμι ὑπὸ ἐξουσίαν τασσόμενος, ἔχων ὑπ’ ἐμαυτὸν στρατιώτας, καὶ λέγω τούτῳ Πορεύθητι, καὶ πορεύεται, καὶ ἄλλῳ Ἔρχου, καὶ ἔρχεται, καὶ τῷ δούλῳ μου Ποίησον τοῦτο, καὶ ποιεῖ.

controles.web: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
controles.kjv: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
controles.livre: Porque também eu sou homem subordinado à autoridade, e tenho soldados sob o meu comando, e digo a este: 'Vai', e ele vai; e a outro: 'Vem', e ele vem; e a meu servo: 'Faz isto', e ele faz”.

versos.grego: ἀκούσας δὲ ταῦτα ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐθαύμασεν αὐτόν, καὶ στραφεὶς τῷ ἀκολουθοῦντι αὐτῷ ὄχλῳ εἶπεν Λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐδὲ ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ τοσαύτην πίστιν εὗρον.

controles.web: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”
controles.kjv: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
controles.livre: Quando Jesus ouviu isso, admirou-se dele; então se virou, e disse à multidão que o seguia: Digo-vos que nem mesmo em Israel achei tanta fé.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑποστρέψαντες εἰς τὸν οἶκον οἱ πεμφθέντες εὗρον τὸν δοῦλον ὑγιαίνοντα.

controles.web: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.
controles.kjv: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
controles.livre: E quando os que foram enviados voltaram para casa, acharam são o servo doente.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἑξῆς ἐπορεύθη εἰς πόλιν καλουμένην Ναΐν, καὶ συνεπορεύοντο αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὄχλος πολύς.

controles.web: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
controles.livre: E aconteceu no dia seguinte, que Jesus ia a uma cidade chamada Naim, e com ele iam muitos de seus discípulos, e uma grande multidão.

versos.grego: ὡς δὲ ἤγγισεν τῇ πύλῃ τῆς πόλεως, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐξεκομίζετο τεθνηκὼς μονογενὴς υἱὸς τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ αὐτὴ ἦν χήρα, καὶ ὄχλος τῆς πόλεως ἱκανὸς ἦν σὺν αὐτῇ.

controles.web: Now when he drew near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.
controles.kjv: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
controles.livre: E quando chegou perto da porta da cidade, eis que levavam um defunto, filho único de sua mãe, que era viúva; e com ela ia grande multidão da cidade.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὴν ὁ Κύριος ἐσπλαγχνίσθη ἐπ’ αὐτῇ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Μὴ κλαῖε.

controles.web: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said to her, “Don’t cry.”
controles.kjv: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
controles.livre: Quando o Senhor a viu, comoveu-se de intima compaixão por ela, e disse-lhe: Não chores.

versos.grego: καὶ προσελθὼν ἥψατο τῆς σοροῦ, οἱ δὲ βαστάζοντες ἔστησαν, καὶ εἶπεν Νεανίσκε, σοὶ λέγω, ἐγέρθητι.

controles.web: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”
controles.kjv: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
controles.livre: Então se aproximou, tocou o caixão (e os que a levavam, pararam), e disse: Jovem, a ti eu digo: levanta-te.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀνεκάθισεν ὁ νεκρὸς καὶ ἤρξατο λαλεῖν, καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸν τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.
controles.kjv: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
controles.livre: E o defunto se sentou e começou a falar; e ele o entregou à sua mãe.

versos.grego: ἔλαβεν δὲ φόβος πάντας, καὶ ἐδόξαζον τὸν Θεὸν λέγοντες ὅτι Προφήτης μέγας ἠγέρθη ἐν ἡμῖν, καὶ ὅτι Ἐπεσκέψατο ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”
controles.kjv: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
controles.livre: Todos se encheram de temor, e glorificavam a Deus, dizendo: “Um grande profeta se levantou entre nós, e Deus visitou o seu povo!”

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ λόγος οὗτος ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ περὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάσῃ τῇ περιχώρῳ.

controles.web: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea, and in all the surrounding region.
controles.kjv: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judea, and throughout all the region round about.
controles.livre: E essa sua fama correu por toda a Judeia, e por toda a região em redor.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν Ἰωάνει οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ περὶ πάντων τούτων. καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος δύο τινὰς τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ὁ Ἰωάνης

controles.web: The disciples of John told him about all these things.
controles.kjv: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
controles.livre: E os discípulos de João lhe anunciaram essas coisas.

versos.grego: ἔπεμψεν πρὸς τὸν Κύριον λέγων Σὺ εἶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος, ἢ ἄλλον προσδοκῶμεν;

controles.web: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”
controles.kjv: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
controles.livre: Então João chamou dois de seus discípulos, e os enviou a Jesus, dizendo: “És tu aquele que havia de vir, ou esperamos outro?”

versos.grego: παραγενόμενοι δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἄνδρες εἶπαν Ἰωάνης ὁ Βαπτιστὴς ἀπέστειλεν ἡμᾶς πρὸς σὲ λέγων Σὺ εἶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος, ἢ ἄλλον προσδοκῶμεν;

controles.web: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”
controles.kjv: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
controles.livre: E quando aqueles homens vieram a ele, disseram: “João Batista nos enviou a ti, dizendo: 'És tu aquele que havia de vir, ou esperamos outro?'”

versos.grego: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐθεράπευσεν πολλοὺς ἀπὸ νόσων καὶ μαστίγων καὶ πνευμάτων πονηρῶν, καὶ τυφλοῖς πολλοῖς ἐχαρίσατο βλέπειν.

controles.web: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.
controles.kjv: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
controles.livre: E naquela mesma hora ele curou a muitos de enfermidades, males, e espíritos maus, e a deu vista a muitos cegos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πορευθέντες ἀπαγγείλατε Ἰωάνει ἃ εἴδετε καὶ ἠκούσατε· τυφλοὶ ἀναβλέπουσιν, χωλοὶ περιπατοῦσιν, λεπροὶ καθαρίζονται, καὶ κωφοὶ ἀκούουσιν, νεκροὶ ἐγείρονται, πτωχοὶ εὐαγγελίζονται·

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
controles.kjv: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
controles.livre: Jesus lhes respondeu: Ide, e anunciai a João as coisas que tendes visto e ouvido: que os cegos veem, os mancos andam, os leprosos são purificados, os surdos ouvem, os mortos ressuscitam, e aos pobres é anunciado o Evangelho.

versos.grego: καὶ μακάριός ἐστιν ὃς ἐὰν μὴ σκανδαλισθῇ ἐν ἐμοί.

controles.web: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
controles.kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
controles.livre: E bendito  é aquele que não se ofender em mim.

versos.grego: Ἀπελθόντων δὲ τῶν ἀγγέλων Ἰωάνου ἤρξατο λέγειν πρὸς τοὺς ὄχλους περὶ Ἰωάνου Τί ἐξήλθατε εἰς τὴν ἔρημον θεάσασθαι; κάλαμον ὑπὸ ἀνέμου σαλευόμενον;

controles.web: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
controles.kjv: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
controles.livre: E quando os mensageiros de João se foram, Jesus começou a dizer às multidões acerca de João: Que saístes para ver no deserto? Alguma cana sacudida pelo vento?

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ τί ἐξήλθατε ἰδεῖν; ἄνθρωπον ἐν μαλακοῖς ἱματίοις ἠμφιεσμένον; ἰδοὺ οἱ ἐν ἱματισμῷ ἐνδόξῳ καὶ τρυφῇ ὑπάρχοντες ἐν τοῖς βασιλείοις εἰσίν.

controles.web: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
controles.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
controles.livre: Mas que saístes para ver? Um homem vestido de roupas delicadas? Eis que os que vestem roupas delicadas e vivem no luxo estão nos palácios reais.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ τί ἐξήλθατε ἰδεῖν; προφήτην; ναί, λέγω ὑμῖν, καὶ περισσότερον προφήτου.

controles.web: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
controles.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
controles.livre: Mas que saístes para ver? Um profeta? Sim, vos digo, e muito mais que profeta.

versos.grego: οὗτός ἐστιν περὶ οὗ γέγραπται Ἰδοὺ ἀποστέλλω τὸν ἄγγελόν μου πρὸ προσώπου σου, ὃς κατασκευάσει τὴν ὁδόν σου ἔμπροσθέν σου.

controles.web: This is he of whom it is written,  ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
controles.kjv: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
controles.livre: Este é aquele de quem está escrito: Eis que envio o meu mensageiro adiante de tua face, o qual preparará o teu caminho diante de ti.

versos.grego: λέγω ὑμῖν, μείζων ἐν γεννητοῖς γυναικῶν Ἰωάνου οὐδείς ἐστιν· ὁ δὲ μικρότερος ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ μείζων αὐτοῦ ἐστιν.

controles.web: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer, yet he who is least in the Kingdom of God is greater than he.”
controles.kjv: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
controles.livre: Pois eu vos digo, que dentre os nascidos de mulheres, não há profeta maior que João, o Batista; mas o menor no Reino dos céus é maior que ele.

versos.grego: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἀκούσας καὶ οἱ τελῶναι ἐδικαίωσαν τὸν Θεόν, βαπτισθέντες τὸ βάπτισμα Ἰωάνου·

controles.web: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.
controles.kjv: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
controles.livre: E todo o povo e os cobradores de impostos ouviram, concordaram que Deus era justo, e foram batizados com o batismo de João.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ οἱ νομικοὶ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἠθέτησαν εἰς ἑαυτούς, μὴ βαπτισθέντες ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.
controles.kjv: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
controles.livre: Mas os fariseus e os estudiosos da Lei rejeitaram o conselho de Deus contra si mesmos, e não foram batizados por ele.

versos.grego: Τίνι οὖν ὁμοιώσω τοὺς ἀνθρώπους τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης, καὶ τίνι εἰσὶν ὅμοιοι;

controles.web: “To what then will I liken the people of this generation? What are they like?
controles.kjv: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
controles.livre: E o Senhor disse: “A quem, pois, compararei as pessoas desta geração? E a quem são semelhantes?

versos.grego: ὅμοιοί εἰσιν παιδίοις τοῖς ἐν ἀγορᾷ καθημένοις καὶ προσφωνοῦσιν ἀλλήλοις ἃ λέγει Ηὐλήσαμεν ὑμῖν καὶ οὐκ ὠρχήσασθε· ἐθρηνήσαμεν καὶ οὐκ ἐκλαύσατε.

controles.web: They are like children who sit in the marketplace, and call one to another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’
controles.kjv: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
controles.livre: São semelhantes às crianças sentadas na praça, que gritam umas às outras: 'Tocamo-vos flautas, mas não dançastes; cantamos-vos lamentações, mas não chorastes'.

versos.grego: ἐλήλυθεν γὰρ Ἰωάνης ὁ Βαπτιστὴς μὴ ἐσθίων ἄρτον μήτε πίνων οἶνον, καὶ λέγετε Δαιμόνιον ἔχει.

controles.web: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
controles.kjv: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
controles.livre: Porque veio João Batista, que não comia pão, nem bebia vinho, e dizeis: 'Ele tem demônio';

versos.grego: ἐλήλυθεν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐσθίων καὶ πίνων, καὶ λέγετε Ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος φάγος καὶ οἰνοπότης, φίλος τελωνῶν καὶ ἁμαρτωλῶν.

controles.web: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man, and a drunkard; a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
controles.kjv: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
controles.livre: Veio o Filho do homem, que come e bebe, e dizeis: 'Eis um homem comilão e bebedor de vinho, amigo dos cobradores de impostos e dos pecadores'.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐδικαιώθη ἡ σοφία ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν τέκνων αὐτῆς.

controles.web: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”
controles.kjv: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
controles.livre: Mas a sabedoria foi considerada justa por todos os seus filhos”.

versos.grego: Ἠρώτα δέ τις αὐτὸν τῶν Φαρισαίων ἵνα φάγῃ μετ’ αὐτοῦ· καὶ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Φαρισαίου κατεκλίθη.

controles.web: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house, and sat at the table.
controles.kjv: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.
controles.livre: E um dos fariseus lhe pediu que comesse com ele; então entrou na casa do fariseu, e sentou-se à mesa .

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ γυνὴ ἥτις ἦν ἐν τῇ πόλει ἁμαρτωλός, καὶ ἐπιγνοῦσα ὅτι κατάκειται ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ τοῦ Φαρισαίου, κομίσασα ἀλάβαστρον μύρου

controles.web: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, she brought an alabaster jar of ointment.
controles.kjv: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
controles.livre: E eis que uma mulher da cidade, que era pecadora, quando soube que ele estava na casa do fariseu, trouxe um vaso de alabastro de óleo perfumado.

versos.grego: καὶ στᾶσα ὀπίσω παρὰ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ κλαίουσα, τοῖς δάκρυσιν ἤρξατο βρέχειν τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ, καὶ ταῖς θριξὶν τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτῆς ἐξέμασσεν, καὶ κατεφίλει τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἤλειφεν τῷ μύρῳ.

controles.web: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
controles.kjv: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
controles.livre: E estando atrás, aos seus pés, chorando, começou a molhar-lhe os pés com lágrimas; e os enxugava com os cabelos da sua cabeça; e beijava-lhe os pés, e os ungia com o óleo perfumado.

versos.grego: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Φαρισαῖος ὁ καλέσας αὐτὸν εἶπεν ἐν ἑαυτῷ λέγων Οὗτος εἰ ἦν προφήτης, ἐγίνωσκεν ἂν τίς καὶ ποταπὴ ἡ γυνὴ ἥτις ἅπτεται αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἁμαρτωλός ἐστιν.

controles.web: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”
controles.kjv: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
controles.livre: E quando o fariseu que o havia convidado viu isso , falou consigo mesmo: Se ele fosse profeta, saberia quem e qual é a mulher que o toca; porque ela é pecadora.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Σίμων, ἔχω σοί τι εἰπεῖν. ὁ δέ Διδάσκαλε, εἰπέ, φησίν.

controles.web: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.”    He said, “Teacher, say on.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhe respondeu: “Simão, tenho uma coisa a te dizer”; e ele disse: “Dize-a, Mestre”.

versos.grego: δύο χρεοφειλέται ἦσαν δανιστῇ τινι· ὁ εἷς ὤφειλεν δηνάρια πεντακόσια, ὁ δὲ ἕτερος πεντήκοντα.

controles.web: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
controles.kjv: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
controles.livre: Jesus disse: “Certo credor tinha dois devedores. Um lhe devia quinhentas moedas de prata, e o outro cinquenta.

versos.grego: μὴ ἐχόντων αὐτῶν ἀποδοῦναι ἀμφοτέροις ἐχαρίσατο. τίς οὖν αὐτῶν πλεῖον ἀγαπήσει αὐτόν;

controles.web: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”
controles.kjv: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
controles.livre: Como não tinham com que pagar, perdoou-lhes a dívida de ambos. Diz, pois, qual deles o amará mais?”

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς Σίμων εἶπεν Ὑπολαμβάνω ὅτι ᾧ τὸ πλεῖον ἐχαρίσατο. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ὀρθῶς ἔκρινας.

controles.web: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.”   He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”
controles.kjv: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
controles.livre: Simão respondeu: Tenho para mim que aquele a quem mais perdoou. E ele lhe disse: Julgaste corretamente.

versos.grego: καὶ στραφεὶς πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα τῷ Σίμωνι ἔφη Βλέπεις ταύτην τὴν γυναῖκα; εἰσῆλθόν σου εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν, ὕδωρ μοι ἐπὶ πόδας οὐκ ἔδωκας· αὕτη δὲ τοῖς δάκρυσιν ἔβρεξέν μου τοὺς πόδας καὶ ταῖς θριξὶν αὐτῆς ἐξέμαξεν.

controles.web: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.
controles.kjv: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
controles.livre: Ele se voltou à mulher, e disse a Simão: Vês tu esta mulher? Entrei na tua casa, e não me deste água para os pés; porém esta molhou os meus pés com lágrimas, e os enxugou com os seu cabelos da cabeça.

versos.grego: φίλημά μοι οὐκ ἔδωκας· αὕτη δὲ ἀφ’ ἧς εἰσῆλθον οὐ διέλειπεν καταφιλοῦσά μου τοὺς πόδας.

controles.web: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
controles.kjv: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
controles.livre: Tu não me beijaste; porém esta, desde que entrou, não parou de me beijar os pés.

versos.grego: ἐλαίῳ τὴν κεφαλήν μου οὐκ ἤλειψας· αὕτη δὲ μύρῳ ἤλειψεν τοὺς πόδας μου.

controles.web: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.
controles.kjv: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
controles.livre: Não ungiste a minha cabeça com óleo, porém esta ungiu os meus pés com óleo perfumado.

versos.grego: οὗ χάριν λέγω σοι, ἀφέωνται αἱ ἁμαρτίαι αὐτῆς αἱ πολλαί, ὅτι ἠγάπησεν πολύ· ᾧ δὲ ὀλίγον ἀφίεται, ὀλίγον ἀγαπᾷ.

controles.web: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little.”
controles.kjv: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
controles.livre: Por isso te digo, os muitos pecados dela são perdoados, porque muito amou; mas ao que pouco se perdoa, pouco ama.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῇ Ἀφέωνταί σου αἱ ἁμαρτίαι.

controles.web: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
controles.livre: E disse a ela: Os teus pecados são perdoados.

versos.grego: καὶ ἤρξαντο οἱ συνανακείμενοι λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς Τίς οὗτός ἐστιν, ὃς καὶ ἁμαρτίας ἀφίησιν;

controles.web: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
controles.kjv: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
controles.livre: E os que estavam sentados começaram a dizer entre si: Quem é este, que até perdoa pecados?

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα Ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε· πορεύου εἰς εἰρήνην.

controles.web: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
controles.kjv: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
controles.livre: E disse à mulher: A tua fé te salvou; vai em paz.
